assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-view game animation sprite sheet, genuinely transparent PNG alpha, landscape 1536x1024. This is an original companion for the Tantalus ship, not Jones and not a memorial pet. High-quality hand-painted pixel-art look, clean readable silhouette suitable for scaling down to 58 pixels high in a modern 2D metroidvania. EXACTLY 32 separate full-body animation poses in a strict uniform 8 columns by 4 rows grid, cells 192x256. Background must be actual alpha transparency, NOT white, black, checkerboard or a painted substitute.
